_doc: Single source of truth for model + effort across the autoport harness. Flip 'active' to switch the WHOLE setup (orchestrator manager, subagent workers, supervisor) in one place, then run .autoport/apply-model-profile.sh and relaunch. orchestrator.py and supervisor.sh read this live; apply-model-profile.sh regenerates the .claude/agents/*.md effort frontmatter (the only spot that can't read JSON at runtime).
